volume in 2021, according to Frost & Sullivan (Beijing) Inc., Shanghai       若斯特沙利文」），按2021年生產╱加工量計
Branch Co., (“Frost & Sullivan”) an independent global consulting            算，本集團仍然是全球最大的獨立焦炭生產
firm. Other than being the largest independent coke producer and             商及供應商。於2021年，除作為全球最大的
supplier of coke in the world, the Group held leading positions in           獨立焦炭生產商及焦炭供應商外，本集團亦
a number of refined chemical sectors in China or globally in 2021.           於中國或全球的多個精細化工產品領域處於
According to Frost & Sullivan, the Group was the largest producer            領先地位。根據弗若斯特沙利文，按2021年
of industrial-naphthalene-based phthalic anhydride and coke-                 數量計算，本集團是中國最大的工業萘製苯
oven-gas-based methanol by volume in China in 2021. The Group was            酐及焦爐煤氣製甲醇生產商。按2021年數量
also the largest coking crude benzene processor and the third largest        計算，本集團亦是全球最大的焦化粗苯加工

               the Group takes into account the characteristics of the asset or               產或負債定價時會考慮資產或負債的

     Contract costs                                                                 合同成本

     Costs to fulfil a contract                                                     履行合同的成本

     The Group incurs costs to fulfil a contract in its sales of products           本集團於產品銷售及服務合約中產生
     and service contracts. The Group first assesses whether these                  履行合同的成本。本集團首先根據其
     costs qualify for recognition as an asset in terms of other relevant           他相關準則評估該等成本是否合資格
     standards, failing which it recognizes an asset for these costs only if        確認為資產，倘不合資格，僅在符合
     they meet all of the following criteria:                                       以下標準後將該等成本確認為資產：

     •     the costs relate directly to a contract or to an anticipated             •    有關成本與本集團可明確識別的
           contract that the Group can specifically identify;                            合同或預期合同有直接關係；

     •     the costs generate or enhance resources of the Group that will           •    有關成本令本集團將用於履行
           be used in satisfying (or in continuing to satisfy) performance              （或持續履行）日後履約義務之資
           obligations in the future; and                                                源得以產生或有所增加；及

     •     the costs are expected to be recovered.                                  •    有關成本預期可收回。

     The asset so recognized is subsequently amortized to profit or                  由此確認的資產隨後按系統性基準於
     loss on a systematic basis that is consistent with the transfer to the          損益攤銷，與轉讓予客戶商品或服務
     customer of the goods or services to which the assets relate. The              （與資產相關）相符。資產須進行減值審
     asset is subject to impairment review.                                          閱。

               Definition of a lease                                                         租賃的定義

               A contract is, or contains, a lease if the contract conveys the right         倘合約給予權利在一段時間內使用已
               to control the use of an identified asset for a period of time in             識別資產以換取代價，則該合約為或
               exchange for consideration.                                                   包含租賃。

               For contracts entered into or modified on or after the date of initial        就於首次應用國際財務報告準則第16
               application of IFRS 16 or arising from business combinations, the             號當日或之後簽訂或修訂的或因業務
               Group assesses whether a contract is or contains a lease based on             合併而產生的合約而言， 本集團於開
               the definition under IFRS 16 at inception or modification date. Such          始或修訂日期根據於國際財務報告準
               contract will not be reassessed unless the terms and conditions of            則第16號項下的定義評估合約是否為
               the contract are subsequently changed.                                        或包含租賃。該合約將不會被重新評
                                                                                             估，除非該合約中的條款與條件隨後
                                                                                             被改動。

               The Group as a lessee                                                         本集團作為承租人

               Allocation of consideration to components of a contract                       分配至合約組成部分的代價

               additional lease or non-lease components, the Group allocates the             額外租賃或非租賃組成部分的合約而
               consideration in the contract to each lease component on the basis            言，本集團根據租賃組成部分的相關
               of the relative stand-alone price of the lease component and the              獨立價格及非租賃組成部分的獨立價
               aggregate stand-alone price of the non-lease components.                      格總額於合約分配代價至各租賃組成
                                                                                             部分。

               The Group applies practical expedient not to separate non-lease               本集團亦採用實際權宜方法，不將非
               components from lease component, and instead account for the                  租賃組成部分與租賃組成部分分開，

                                                                                             分。

               commencement date and do not contain a purchase option. It also               期十二個月或以下並且不包括購買選
               applies the recognition exemption for lease of low-value assets.              擇權。本集團亦對低價值資產租賃應
               Lease payments on short-term leases and leases of low-value assets            用確認豁免。短期租賃及低價值資產
               are recognized as expense on a straight-line basis over the lease             租賃的租賃付款按直線基準於租期內

     with sufficient reliability.                                                    量，因此不予確認。

     Where the Group is jointly and severally liable for an obligation, the          倘本集團對一項義務承擔連帶及個別
     part of the obligation that is expected to be met by other parties              責任，則該責任中預期由其他方履行
     is treated as a contingent liability and it is not recognised in the            的部分被視為或然負債，且不在綜合
     consolidated financial statements.                                              財務報表中確認。

     resources embodying economic benefits has become probable. If                   濟利益的資源是否可能流出。倘先前
     it becomes probable that an outflow of future economic benefits will            作為或然負債處理的項目將可能需要

     a provision is recognised in the consolidated financial statements              動的報告期內於綜合財務報表中確認

               Measurement and recognition of ECL                                               預期信貸虧損的計量及確認

               The measurement of ECL is a function of the probability of default,              預期信貸虧損的計量乃指違約概率、
               loss given default (i.e. the magnitude of the loss if there is a default)        違約損失率（即倘違約引致損失的程度）
               and the exposure at default. The assessment of the probability                   及達約風險的函數。評估違約概率及
               of default and loss given default is based on historical data and                違約損失率根據過往數據及前瞻性資
               forward-looking information. Estimation of ECL reflects an unbiased              料而作出。預期信貸虧損的估計反映
               and probability-weighted amount that is determined with the                      無偏頗及概率加權的數額，其乃根據
               respective risks of default occurring as the weights. The Group                  加權的相應違約風險蘆定。本集團採
               uses a practical expedient in estimating ECL on trade receivables                用可行權宜方法，利用撥備矩陣估計
               using a provision matrix taking into consideration historical credit             貿易應收款項的預期信貸虧捐，當中
               loss experience, adjusted for forward looking information that is                計及過往信貸虧損經驗，並根據毋須
               available without undue cost and effort.                                         付出不必要努力即可獲得的前職性資
                                                                                                料進行調整。
               Generally, the ECL is estimated as the difference between all
               contractual cash flows that are due to the Group in accordance                   一般而言，預期信貸虧損估計為本集
               with the contract and all the cash flows that the Group expects to               團根據合約應收的所有合約現金流量
               receive, discounted at the effective interest rate determined at initial         與本集團預計收取的所有現金流量之
               recognition.                                                                     間的差額，並按初始確認時釐定的實
                                                                                                際利率貼現。
               For a financial guarantee contract, the Group is required to make
               payments only in the event of a default by the debtor in accordance              就財務擔保合約而言，本集團須僅在
               with the terms of the instrument that is guaranteed. Accordingly, the            債務人違反保證文書條款的情況下作
               ECL is the present value of the expected payments to reimburse                   出付款。因此，預期信貸虧損是償還
               the holder for a credit loss that it incurs less any amounts that the            持有人信貸損失的預期付款的現值，
               Group expects to receive from the holder, the debtors or any other               該信貸損失減去本集團預期從持有
               party.                                                                           人、債務人或任何其他方獲得的任何
                                                                                                金額。

               rate that reflects the current market assessment of the time value of            反映目前對貨幣時間價值的市場評估
               money and the risks that are specific to the cash flows but only if,             及該現金流特定風險的貼現率，惟僅
               and to the extent that, the risks are taken into account by adjusting            限於風險按調整貼現率而非調整所貼
               the discount rate instead of adjusting the cash shortfalls being                 現的現金不足納入考慮時。

36. RESERVES                                                                 36. 儲備

   Share premium                                                                 股份溢價

   Under the Companies Law (Revised) of the Cayman Islands,                      根據開曼群島公司法（經修訂），計入本
   amount included in the share premium account of the Company                   公司股份溢價賬中的金額可分派予本
   is distributable to the shareholders of the Company provided that             公司股東，前提是緊隨建議分派股息
   immediately following the date on which the dividend is proposed to           日期後本公司將有能力在日常業務過
   be distributed, the Company will be in a position to pay off its debts        程中償還到期債務。
   as and when they fall due in the ordinary course of business.

   Merger reserve                                                                合併儲備

   The merger reserve represents the difference between the nominal              合併儲備指本公司已發行股本面值╱
   value of the share capital issued/consideration paid by the                   已付代價與根據本集團重組所收購附
   Company and the aggregate capital of the subsidiaries acquired                屬公司合計資本之間的差額，根據合
   pursuant to the group reorganization, accounted for as capital                併會計基準作為最終控股公司的注資
   contribution from/distribution to ultimate holding company under              入賬╱分派。
   merger basis of accounting.

   During the year ended December 31, 2021, the Group acquired                   截至2021年12月31日止年度期間，本
   100% equity interest or share capital of RMB205,000,000 in                    集團以現金收購唐山旭陽化工有限公司
   Tangshan Risun Petroleum at the consideration of RMB570,000,000               100%權益或股本人民幣205,000,000
   paid in cash and accounted for as business acquisition under                  元，代價為人民幣570,000,000元，作
   common control.                                                               為共同控制下的業務收購入賬。

   Reserve fund                                                                  儲備基金

   The Articles of Association of certain PRC subsidiaries require the           若干中國附屬公司的組織章程細則要
   appropriation of 10% of their profit after tax each year, based on            求每年根據其法定經審核財務報表將
   their statutory audited financial statements, to the reserve fund until       其除稅後溢利的10%撥入儲備基金，
   the balance reaches 50% of the registered capital of the respective           直至結餘達到相應中國附屬公司註冊
   PRC subsidiaries. The reserve fund may be capitalized as the paid-            資本的50%。儲備基金可資本化為該
   in capital of these subsidiaries.                                             等附屬公司的實收資本。

   Safety fund                                                                   安全基金

   Pursuant to relevant PRC regulation, the Group is required to                 根據相關中國法規，本集團須將核心
   transfer 1.5% on revenue generated from the core business into a              業務產生的收益1.5%轉入指定基金。
   designated fund. The fund will be used for installation and repair            該基金將用於安全設施的安裝、維修
   and maintenance of safety facilities. The movements in the reporting          和保養。於報告期內變動指根據中國
   periods represent the difference between the amounts provided                 相關法規計提的金額與年內使用金額
   based on the relevant PRC regulation and the amount utilized                  之間的差額。
   during the year.

40. CAPITAL MANAGEMENT                                                     40. 資本管理

   The Group’s primary objectives of managing capital are to                   本集團管理資本的主要目的是維護其
   safeguard the Group’s ability to continue as a going concern, and to        持續經營的能力，從而使其能夠透過
   provide returns for shareholders and benefits for other stakeholders,       按合理成本取得融資，繼續為股東提
   by securing access to finance at a reasonable cost.                         供回報及為其他持份者提供利益。

   The Group actively and regularly reviews and manages its capital            本集團積極及定期檢討和管理其資本
   structure to maintain a balance between the higher shareholder              架構，以在維持較高借款水平可能帶
   returns that might be possible with higher levels of borrowings, and        來的高股東回報取得平衡，並因應不
   makes adjustments to the capital structure in light of changes in           同的經濟狀況為資本架構作出調整。
   economic conditions.

   Based on recommendations of the board of directors, the Group will          根據董事會建議，本集團將透過調整
   balance its overall capital structure through adjusting the amount          向股東派付的股息金額、發行新股、
   of dividends paid to shareholders, issuing of new shares, raising           籌集新債務融資或出售資產以減少債
   new debt financing or selling assets to reduce debt. During the             務，藉以平衡其整體資本架構。於報
   reporting period, there were no changes in the objectives, policies         告期內，並無更改目標、政策或程
   or processes.                                                               序。.

   The Group monitors capital with reference to its debt position. The         本集團透過參考其債務狀況監察資
   Group’s strategy was to maintain the equity and debt in a balanced          本。本集團的策略為將權益與債項維
   position and ensure there was adequate working capital to service           持在一個平衡的位置，並確保擁有足
   its debt obligation.                                                        夠的營運資金償還其債務。

   There are fundamental differences between IBORs and the various                倫敦銀行同業拆借利率與各類可替代
   alternative benchmark rates. IBORs are forward looking term rates              基準利率間存在重大差異。倫敦銀行
   published for a period (e.g. 3 months) at the beginning of that                同業拆借利率為於某期初就一段期間
   period and include an inter-bank credit spread, whereas alternative           （例如3個月）發佈的前瞻性期限利率，
   benchmark rates are typically risk-free overnight rates published at           並包括銀行間信貸息差，而可替代基
   the end of the overnight period with no embedded credit spread.                準利率通常為於隔夜期末發佈無嵌入
   These differences will result in additional uncertainty regarding              信貸息差的無風險隔夜利率。該等差
   floating rate interest payments.                                               異將導致有關浮息利率付款的額外不
                                                                                  確定性。

   Liquidity risk                                                                 流動資金風險

   The additional uncertainty on various alternative rates which are              各類可替代利率的額外不確定性通常
   typically published on overnight basis will require additional liquidity       按隔夜基礎發佈，將需要額外流動資
   management. The Group has established liquidity risk management                金管理。本集團已制訂流動資金風險
   policy to ensure sufficient liquid resources to accommodate                    管理政策，以確保擁有充足流動資
   unexpected increases in overnight rates.                                       源，應對隔夜利率不可預期的增長。

   differing interpretation of existing fallback terms), there is a risk of       起），則可能存在與交易對手長期糾紛
